objective: Attempt to falsify whether the active 180-second public-testnet block interval remains technically defensible across network, DAA/timestamp, capacity/UX, mining-economics, decentralization and recovery evidence.
frozen_principles: Orient with Bitcoin; justify with FAE evidence

reopening_justification.new_question: direct validation of the actually active 180-second public-testnet parameter
reopening_justification.anti_evidence_manufacture_rule: The v2 pre-L3 ceiling remains binding for 300/600/900. New simulation is admissible only where it tests a 180-specific property, the live v4 DAA/timestamp behavior, or a newly explicit falsification hypothesis.
reopening_justification.critical_method_gap: The live 180s v4 DAA is a 20-block discrete retarget with ±2-bit clamp; the v2 DAA results are based on an anchored ASERT-style research proxy and are not direct evidence for the active 180s DAA.

existing_evidence.proved: block-time changes couple to monetary calendar, maturity, capacity, propagation/stale semantics, DAA observation density and mining-event frequency
300/600/900 ASERT-style proxy, propagation sensitivity, payout variance and confirmation normalization; not direct proof of 180s live DAA
precommitted propagation thresholds, Wilson stale bounds, comparable-throughput admission and fail-closed external evidence structure
real three-region WAN propagation for 300/600/900 and rare-event limitations; forbids short/synthetic evidence manufacture
arrival-clock hardening semantics and ±30s clock envelope for candidate path; not retroactive proof of public v4 120s timestamp behavior
TARGET_SECONDS=180, RETARGET_INTERVAL=20, discrete ±2-bit retarget, 120s live future timestamp wall, 20 tx/block ceiling and active economics
FAIL due harness abort; before abort no observed stales/reorgs and ~128ms P95; cannot be promoted to PASS
FAIL with ~208s Frankfurt isolation/recovery divergence exceeding frozen 180s outage bound; no observed stales/reorgs and ~128ms P95 do not erase failure
PREPARED_NOT_STARTED; must remain separate from this research and cannot be inferred PASS

evidence_classes.deterministic_local: Exact arithmetic, active-core invariants, DAA state-machine tests, timestamp boundary tests, capacity/economic calculations.
evidence_classes.simulation: Seeded stochastic or adversarial models; must record seed/model/assumptions and never be described as observed network evidence.
evidence_classes.replay: Historical or synthetic chain/event replay through exact active algorithms; preserves provenance and source revision.
evidence_classes.external_data: Public primary data/papers/blockchain datasets with source, population, period, FAE relevance, limitations and comparability label.
evidence_classes.wan_physical: Multi-host, real-network or device evidence; external dependency and never substituted by simulation.

evidence_admission.PASS: source/provenance, environment or population, period, metric definition, FAE relevance, limitations and direct-vs-directional comparability are all explicit
evidence_admission.WARN: usable directional evidence with one or more material comparability limits explicitly bounded
evidence_admission.FAIL: missing provenance, incompatible population/metric, hidden synthetic substitution, or unsupported direct-comparability claim

propagation.p99: mandatory reporting when raw distribution permits; no fabricated hard threshold
propagation.PASS: admissible comparable-throughput 180s evidence satisfies all inherited absolute thresholds and reports tails
propagation.WARN: latency is below hard failure thresholds but evidence is undersampled, tails unavailable, or only directionally comparable
propagation.FAIL: admissible directly comparable 180s evidence violates median/mean/P95 absolute thresholds

stale_fork.PASS: natural/admissible sample meets Wilson upper bounds; zero observed events alone is not sufficient below the required sample size
stale_fork.WARN: no material stale/reorg signal but confidence is insufficient or evidence is synthetic/serialized
stale_fork.FAIL: admissible evidence shows a persistent material stale/fork/reorg regime or a confidence interval incompatible with the frozen bound

live_daa.implementation: active v4 20-block retarget, expected span 19*180s, rounded log2 adjustment clamped to ±2 bits and bits bounds 12..28
live_daa.PASS: all deterministic invariants hold; seeded distributions converge after shocks without persistent limit-cycle, floor/ceiling lock or timestamp-induced directional easing advantage
live_daa.WARN: bounded oscillation/recovery tail exists without safety violation but materially worsens confirmation/mining experience or evidence remains model-sensitive
live_daa.FAIL: non-convergence after hashrate stabilizes, persistent pathological oscillation, floor/ceiling lock under in-envelope recovery, or reproducible timestamp strategy creates material directional difficulty advantage

timestamp.active_rule: public v4 +120s future wall and non-decreasing timestamps
timestamp.candidate_reference: Difficulty + Timestamp II 90s arrival wall with ±30s host skew envelope is directional only
timestamp.PASS: active-rule replay/adversarial tests preserve valid-chain admission, reject out-of-bound future timestamps and do not create exploitable DAA distortion; clock-health metric remains independent
timestamp.WARN: network safety holds but active 120s semantics leave measurable DAA sensitivity or operational clock-health uncertainty
timestamp.FAIL: in-envelope/admissible timestamp manipulation causes consensus divergence, durable invalid state, or material reproducible difficulty exploitation

capacity_ux.PASS: 180s arithmetic and burst simulations show bounded mempool behavior within the stated workload envelope and confirmation metrics are reported in wall-clock terms
capacity_ux.WARN: capacity is adequate only under narrow load assumptions or queue/tail waiting grows materially
capacity_ux.FAIL: precommitted workload produces unbounded backlog or confirmation behavior incompatible with the stated user-journey envelope

mining_payout.PASS: solo event frequency/variance and normalized reward comparisons show no material centralization pressure within the tested miner-share envelope
mining_payout.WARN: small miners experience material payout lumpiness/pool incentive but without a demonstrated protocol-safety failure
mining_payout.FAIL: tested economics create a structural dependence on pooling/coordinator behavior inconsistent with general-purpose, non-custodial participation goals

decentralization.PASS: no tested latency/bandwidth/geography/miner-size sensitivity yields a material persistent advantage after normalizing for work
decentralization.WARN: directional advantage exists but magnitude or real-world representativeness remains unresolved
decentralization.FAIL: direct/admissible evidence shows a systematic material advantage for low-latency/datacenter/large-miner operation attributable to 180s timing

outage_recovery.PASS: fresh admissible recovery evidence satisfies its frozen bound with deterministic state convergence and no value/fork-choice corruption
outage_recovery.WARN: software replay recovers correctly but real multi-host evidence is absent or historical failures remain unresolved
outage_recovery.FAIL: fresh directly comparable run exceeds its frozen recovery bound or fails deterministic state convergence

frontiers.name: Canonical Boundary + Build Colony Freeze

frontiers.name: 180s Deterministic Economics, Capacity + UX Baseline

frontiers.name: Active-v4 180s DAA Shock + Oscillation Lab
frontiers.exit: Exact live DAA is exercised across precommitted shock/timestamp/low-hash scenarios with reproducible seeds and verdict.

frontiers.name: 180s Timestamp/DAA Coupling
frontiers.exit: 120s active timestamp rule and candidate hardening lessons are separated; adversarial clock/timestamp effects quantified.

frontiers.name: Propagation + Stale/Fork Evidence Reconciliation
frontiers.exit: V1/V2 and v2 WAN evidence are reclassified; P50/P95/P99/race ratios and Wilson confidence are reported without converting zero events into safety proof.

frontiers.name: Mining Economics + Payout Variance
frontiers.exit: Miner-share event frequency, variance, solo waiting and pool-pressure are measured for 180/300/600 under actual and normalized issuance views.

frontiers.name: Decentralization Sensitivity
frontiers.exit: Latency/bandwidth/geography/miner-size sensitivities are quantified with evidence limits explicit.

frontiers.name: Outage/Partition/Recovery Replay
frontiers.exit: 208s V2 case and partition/eclipselike/peer-starvation/backlog cases are replayed or modeled; historical FAIL remains preserved.

frontiers.name: External Public Evidence Review
frontiers.exit: Primary/public research and datasets are admitted with population/period/relevance/limitations/directness metadata.

frontiers.name: Comparative Synthesis 180/300/600
frontiers.exit: Trade-offs are synthesized without forcing a winner and without changing the v2 research incumbent by implication.

frontiers.name: Independent Software Verification + Evidence Ledger
frontiers.exit: Exact-source harness/results are independently checked; failures and retries remain append-only.

frontiers.name: Terminal Research Verdict
frontiers.exit: Exactly one frozen terminal verdict is issued with research-only authority.

frontiers.name: WAN/Physical/Natural-Event Evidence Gate
frontiers.exit: Fresh directly comparable external evidence is admitted or explicitly remains missing; Stability Soak V3 remains a separate gate.

parallelization_policy.rule: Parallelize independent evidence surfaces; serialize shared state, synthesis, verification and verdict.

terminal_verdicts.SUPPORTED_WITHIN_CURRENT_EVIDENCE: No frozen hard gate has materially failed and every evidence class declared required for the claim has sufficient admissible coverage. This does not authorize activation.
terminal_verdicts.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: No material falsifying result is established, but one or more required evidence classes remain statistically or operationally inadequate.
terminal_verdicts.MATERIAL_RISK_FOUND: At least one frozen hard gate has a reproducible material failure under direct/admissible 180s evidence or a software-only falsification survives verification.

termination_condition: The workstream ends only after software-admissible frontiers are exhausted, external evidence status is explicit, independent verification is complete, and F180-12 emits one frozen terminal research verdict. No verdict changes active consensus.
